input_description: Single tree_0_0_0.dat file (1.06 GB) from the Shin-Uchuu simulation (Ishiyama et al. 2021). Rockstar halo finder + Consistent Trees tree builder. 61 columns (standard 59 + Halfmass_Radius + rvmax). Cosmology: Omega_M=0.30890, h=0.67740, box_size=140 Mpc/h, 6400^3 particles, m_particle=8.97e5 Msun/h. 70 snapshots (snap_idx 0-69). Output format: lhalo_binary.
resolutions: n_snapshots=70 (snap_idx 0-69) for Shin-Uchuu added to simulation_params.particle_mass_note
